nodes.label: redis service (redis:7, allkeys-lru)
nodes.rationale: Started with --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru; the default noeviction rejects writes at the ceiling instead of making room, which is wrong for a cache where every entry is disposable and re-fetchable.

nodes.label: redpanda service (Kafka API, dual listener)
nodes.rationale: Advertises internal://redpanda:29092 for in-network clients and external://localhost:9092 for host clients, so both the containers and the IDE-run JVMs can connect.

nodes.label: searxng service (port 8080)
nodes.rationale: Owns host port 8080, which is why the three Spring apps had to be moved to 8081/8082/8083.

nodes.label: extractor service (build: ./extractor)
nodes.rationale: The only service built from a local recipe rather than a prebuilt image; its healthcheck uses python -c urllib.request because the slim base image has no curl.
